deflection_zh: 身體不舒服要告訴大人，我們去問爸爸媽媽好嗎？

5-6: 簡單說明：生病是身體在努力變好
說明：醫生和護士會照顧好身體
告訴孩子：生病不是孩子的錯
問孩子：有哪裡不舒服嗎？
7-8: 說明病的原因和治療方式，語氣平靜
不確定的事情，老實說不知道
鼓勵孩子把擔心說出來，不要藏著
可以一起畫卡片，送給生病的人

what_not_to_say: 不要說「很快就會好」或保證結果
不要說「打針一定不會痛」這種絕對的話
不要用嚇人的話解釋生病，例如「會死掉」

sources.title: HealthyChildren.org - From the American Academy of Pediatrics

author: claude-haiku

en.deflection: Thank you for telling me. Let's ask mom or dad together, okay?
triggers: i have to go to the hospital

5-6: Explain simply: being sick means the body is working hard to get better.
Say: doctors and nurses will take good care of your body.
Tell your child that getting sick is never the child's fault.
Ask: is there anywhere that feels uncomfortable?
7-8: Explain the cause and treatment calmly, in a steady voice.
If you don't know something, honestly say you're not sure.
Encourage them to share worries instead of keeping them inside.
Make cards together to send to someone who is sick.

what_not_to_say: Don't promise 'you'll get better soon' or guarantee results.
Don't say 'the shot will never hurt' as if it's certain.
Don't scare them with words like 'you will die' when explaining illness.
